notes:
Lead: inbound from product sign-up form. Small teletherapy/wellness platform focused on asynchronous chat + therapist workflow augmentation. Primary contact: Leah Kim (Head of Product). Key context:
- Use case: triage-chat for intake, summarize session notes, embed knowledge base for therapist search.
- Preference: start with hosted API (self-serve) because quick time-to-value; may consider Dedicated later if retention/BAA needs push them.
- "HIPAA-adjacent" concern: they transmit patient messages and clinician notes; they currently pseudonymize before analysis but want clear policy on what Redwood stores and for how long. Quote from Leah: "We don't expect full HIPAA right away, but we can't risk logs retaining PII. What's your recommended path for a small company?"
- Security asks: do you offer a BAA for hosted customers? If not, what controls (retention, log redaction, kms) mitigate risk? They specifically requested deletion API or configurable retention windows (30/90/365 days) and assurance that audit logs don't include message bodies.
- Latency/throughput: low-latency for chat (p95 < 350ms for 1k chars typical); throughput modest (peak 5-10 concurrent chats). Cost sensitivity: target <$0.02 per conversational session on average.
- Models: Open to open and closed models; want Redwood guidance on compressed quantized variants for cost savings. Interested in Optimize suggestions for batching/caching since they have predictable intake patterns.
- Integration: will use REST SDK, react frontend, server-side proxy. Need IP allowlist and token rotation guidance.
- Next technical deep-dive items: retention controls demo, where logs live, sample DPA/BAA language, demo of model selection & cost estimates for their workload.
- Action items: send security FAQ + DPA/DPA-exception path; propose 2x SE slots for 60-min deep dive; prepare short POC template and pointer to anonymization best practices.
- Stated timeline: want POC within 3 weeks, decision horizon ~4-6 weeks depending on legal review.
